# UX loop capture archive

Binary captures (PNG/JPG/WebM/MP4/gzipped traces) from UX rounds 1-57 and every expansion study were moved out of git to keep the repository small; text records (runtime.md, grader JSON and logs, findings, rubrics, scripts) and all of round 58 remain in docs/ux-loop/. Captain decision 2026-10-04: archive captures, keep text.

Archive: `/Users/janustsen/dev/firstmate/data/cb-home-cards/ux-loop-archive/` on janus-mac (outside the repository). 33623 files, 6.22 GB raw: 33556 files as they stood at the last commit before archiving (same relative paths), plus 67 earlier versions of overwritten files under `_superseded/<path>.<git-blob-prefix>`. Each file was exported from its git blob and re-verified against the blob hash and the sha256 below. The pre-archive branch head is preserved as `backup/cb-home-cards-pre-archive` (d06a8535) in the local repository.

Verify from the archive root:

```sh
cd /Users/janustsen/dev/firstmate/data/cb-home-cards/ux-loop-archive
sed -n '/^```sha256$/,/^```$/p' <repo>/docs/ux-loop/ARCHIVE-MANIFEST.md | grep -v '```' | shasum -a 256 -c --quiet
```
